SMTO-MAN-0009 — Some SMTO Manual reference pages are still being prepared

GUID: c7ca60ab-3329-5bf9-bf9a-0c77f975eb99
Slug: docs-generated-warming
Domain: MAN · Subsystem: docs

What happened

  • SMTO is still building some Manual pages, such as detailed error pages, in the background. The main Manual guides already work, and these pages will be ready shortly.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Wait about 30 seconds, then open the link again, for example by selecting Explain this error again. SMTO prepares these pages once after it starts, and they open normally when that finishes.
  2. Meanwhile, use the How to fix steps in this panel or the main Manual guides. Those are available now and don't depend on the pages still being prepared.

What success looks like

  • The Manual page opens and shows its content.

If it still fails

  • If the page still isn't ready after several minutes, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't keep reopening the link every few seconds; it won't make the pages ready sooner.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A generated Manual reference was requested while the generated reference pages are still being built in the background or not yet published; the retry hint is 30 seconds.

What this means

  • A generated reference is requested while its background lane is warming, or a reader still holds the earlier authored snapshot during publication. Manual lookup diagnostics describe local snapshot availability and validation. They neither fetch external documentation nor rebuild content during rendering; generated-lane failure does not invalidate an available authored corpus.

Why this can happen

  • A generated reference is requested while its background lane is warming, or a reader still holds the earlier authored snapshot during publication.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect generated_lane_status and retry_after_seconds for the current snapshot.

How to fix it

  • Wait for the retry hint (30 seconds) and request the generated reference once more; authored Manual content remains available meanwhile. If it stays in the warming state, check the Server log for the manual-references background worker.
  • Use current authored guidance now; wait for the retry hint before one later generated lookup.

Retry and execution caution

  • Use current authored guidance now; wait for the retry hint before one later generated lookup.

How to verify the fix

  • A later bounded lookup after the retry hint observes ready generated content or its explicit failure state.

What not to do

  • Do not invent references, read arbitrary files through Docs or retry in a tight loop.

Technical notes

  • Manual lookup diagnostics describe local snapshot availability and validation. They neither fetch external documentation nor rebuild content during rendering; generated-lane failure does not invalidate an available authored corpus.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
